novel_attack: SELF-REFUTATION CROSS-CHECK: intersect each strategy's role=='trigger' steps against that SAME strategy's own source_gaps. A mechanical literal-quote-substring validator structurally cannot catch this because every quote passes substring presence individually -- the defect lives in the RELATION between two fields. Result: 4 of the 5 strategies asserting an entry trigger simultaneously declare that trigger undefined in their own source_gaps (s0, s1, s2, s5). Only s3 is self-consistent; only s4 correctly declines to assert a trigger. Stated fairly: this is not deception -- the gap is disclosed every time. The defect is a CONSUMER-CONTRACT HAZARD: any compiler reading role=='trigger' as executable emits four entry conditions whose own record says they are undefined. Companion attack, same class: the evidence-disjointness test in F-1.
